_doc: Add a layout = append an entry (id, hero/nav/card/spacing). Hub lists these for per-site selection; gallery shows them. Archetype logic stays in layout-archetypes.ts.

entries.name: Conversational Hero
entries.description: Chat interface as the hero — user types, AI responds. Action is the UI.

entries.name: Magazine Editorial
entries.description: Asymmetric hero, large typography, content-first layout like editorial sites.

entries.name: SaaS Dashboard Landing
entries.description: Marketing page that previews a dashboard. For tool/SaaS products.

entries.name: Finance Terminal
entries.description: Data-dense, green-on-dark, Bloomberg-inspired. For finance/tracking tools.

entries.name: Gamified Learning
entries.description: Duolingo-style: streaks, XP, progress bars, friendly characters.

entries.name: Travel Magazine
entries.description: Full-bleed photography, destination cards, wanderlust-inducing layout.

entries.name: Marketing Calendar
entries.description: Calendar/planning UI as hero. Grid-first layout like Notion/Linear.

entries.name: Compliance Authority
entries.description: Trust-first, government-adjacent feel. Clean, authoritative, reassuring.

entries.name: Bento Showcase
entries.description: Asymmetric tile grid where every tile is a live mini-demo. Strong for multi-feature products.

entries.name: Tool-First Workbench
entries.description: The product itself is the page: input and output panels above the fold, no marketing hero.

entries.name: Story Scroll
entries.description: Chaptered narrative with sticky visual that changes per section. For products explained as a journey.

entries.name: Directory & Marketplace
entries.description: Search-led listing page with filters, result cards and a detail drawer.

entries.name: Board Workspace
entries.description: Columns of draggable cards; the board is the landing demo.

entries.name: Map First
entries.description: Full-bleed map or spatial canvas with floating panel. For location and route products.

entries.name: Docs & Knowledge
entries.description: Sidebar tree plus reading column plus on-page outline. For reference-heavy products.

entries.name: Compare & Decide
entries.description: Side-by-side comparison as the hero. For tools where the choice is the product.

entries.name: Media Gallery
entries.description: Full-bleed visual wall with a carousel strip. For creative, video and image products.
